text: TAG Heuer is one of the Maisons in LVMH's Watches & Jewelry division, so its ultimate parent is LVMH SE, a Euronext Paris-listed luxury group controlled by the Arnault family. There is no state stake in that chain. The Red Bull partnership is therefore private family-controlled corporate money.
